# NYC Taxi — Vendor Comparison

```{tags} reference, query-template, nyctaxi
```

> [NYC Taxi](../../nyctaxi.md) benchmark · [all NYC Taxi queries](index.md)

Compare vendors by various metrics

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  vendor_id,
  COUNT(*) AS trip_count,
  AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_distance,
  AVG(total_amount) AS avg_fare,
  AVG(tip_amount) AS avg_tip,
  SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM trips
WHERE
  pickup_datetime >= '2019-11-08' AND pickup_datetime < '2019-12-08'
GROUP BY
  vendor_id
ORDER BY
  trip_count DESC
```
